The left hand carries the bass and harmony in steady steps while the right hand carries the melody, and the sections return and vary so the song is heard whole, never as a fragment. To play it, start slowly, learn each section in turn, then join them at tempo, listening for the melody above the bass. The song lasts 83.5 seconds at tempo and holds 314 notes in total.

body: Signature Medieval Suite is a complete medieval suite piano song from the medieval, written in F major in 4/4 at 104 beats per minute across 32 bars, in the form A A B A. The medieval suite form gathers chant, estampie, saltarello and ductia manners into one complete song, so each section shows a different medieval colour while the whole holds together. The left hand carries the bass and harmony in steady steps while the right hand carries the melody, and the sections return and vary so the song is heard whole, never as a fragment. To play it, start slowly, learn each section in turn, then join them at tempo, listening for the melody above the bass. The song lasts 73.8 seconds at tempo and holds 320 notes in total.
